definitions: Especially, being of the wild type: being of an unbroken ancestral line of undomesticated animals, as opposed to being feral, being an undomesticated animal whose ancestors were domesticated.
Intended to be synchronized with film or video but recorded separately.
A very wise person or spiritual teacher; someone of gravity and wisdom, especially, a teacher venerable for years, and of sound judgment and prudence; a grave or stoic philosopher.

blocks.text: Wild sage is a common name for several plants and may refer to:

items:
Salvia, a genus of plants commonly called "sage"
Salvia nemorosa – woodland sage
Salvia urticifolia – nettleleaf sage
Salvia verbenaca – clary sage
Artemisia, a genus of plants including some called "sage" or "sagebrush"

blocks.text: Sage is a grey-green resembling that of dried sage leaves. As a quaternary color, it is an equal mix of the tertiary colors citron and slate. The hex RGB color value of the adjacent sage swatch is BCB88A. For decades, some military flight jackets were made in sage green.
